# CCWS Documentation

> CCWS documentation helps users install Codex, register a CCWS account, recharge, create an API Key, configure Codex, configure CC Switch, use Codex image generation, and troubleshoot common setup or request errors.

## Canonical Sites

- Website: https://www.ccws.pro/
- Documentation: https://docs.ccws.pro/
- Support guide: https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/support

## Key Facts

- CCWS provides documentation for Codex users who need a stable OpenAI-compatible API base URL and API Key configuration.
- For Codex, CC Switch, and tools that ask for an OpenAI-compatible Base URL, use `https://www.ccws.pro/v1`.
- The root service URL is `https://www.ccws.pro`.
- Users create their own API Key in the CCWS console. Do not paste real API Keys into chat windows, screenshots, public repositories, or shared documents.
- Recommended Codex setup path: install Codex, register or log in to CCWS, recharge the account, create an API Key, configure CCWS in CC Switch, then verify Codex with a simple request.
- Recommended CC Switch provider fields: provider name `CCWS`, website `https://www.ccws.pro`, API request URL `https://www.ccws.pro/v1`, and the user's current CCWS API Key.
- Manual Codex configuration should use `base_url = "https://www.ccws.pro/v1"` in the Codex provider config and store the API Key outside project repositories.
- CCWS Codex Image Skill uses the environment variable `CCWS_IMAGE_API_KEY`.
- The Codex image generation API Key should support `model: gpt-image-2`.
- If a request fails, check account balance, API Key validity, Base URL, model name, network connectivity, and the tool's full error log before contacting support.

## Chinese Summary

- CCWS 文档入口：https://docs.ccws.pro/
- CCWS 官网：https://www.ccws.pro/
- Codex、CC Switch 和 OpenAI 兼容工具的 Base URL：`https://www.ccws.pro/v1`
- API Key 需要用户自己在 CCWS 控制台创建，不应在聊天窗口、截图、公开仓库或共享文档中暴露。
- Codex 生图技能使用环境变量 `CCWS_IMAGE_API_KEY`，对应 Key 需要支持 `gpt-image-2`。
